name: era-one
description: Drive play into era 1 (1940) so its per-slot enemy-craft update (serviceEra1EnemyCraftSlot) and era-1 objects run, and pixel-validate them against MAME.
_grounding: Same held-era recipe as era-advance (0xAD04 holds the RAW era 0..4), poked to 1. Like era-advance, 'responded' confirms the held era poke landed in the golden; that serviceEra1EnemyCraftSlot actually runs inside the diffed window is measured separately by a reach probe (dispatch count), not implied by the cell.
